read: Management consistently executes ahead of schedule on core power transformer capacity expansions and PBT margin targets. However, timelines for acquired niche projects like G.G. Tronics KAVACH shipments experience delays.
questions: When will RDSO approvals for G.G. Tronics be completed to commence commercial KAVACH shipments?
What is the current status and supply timeline for EV motor approvals mentioned in earlier calls?
What is the updated expected commissioning date for the 45,000 MVA greenfield transformer plant?
bull: Power Systems standalone PBIT margins expanded 209 bps YoY to 23% in Q1 FY27.
Order backlog grew 45% YoY to Rs 18,965 crore, providing multi-quarter revenue visibility.
Power transformer capacity expanded to 75,000 MVA ahead of original execution schedules.
bear: KAVACH shipments missed the December 2025 timeline due to pending RDSO approvals.
Semiconductor investments created a Rs 43 crore headwind on Q1 FY27 consolidated margins.
Cash flow from operations declined from Rs 1,028 crore in FY24 to Rs 702 crore in FY26.
